01.title: Page report history by scheduled time
01.expected_code_only: Cursor uses only `scheduled_at < ?`, skipping rows that share the same `scheduled_at` timestamp across a page boundary.

02.title: Stream the report export
02.expected_code_only: Replacing `csv.writer` with `','.join(map(str, row))` breaks CSV escaping when `report` contains commas, quotes, or newlines.

03.title: Batch queued deliveries
03.expected_code_only: `range(0, len(jobs) - batch_size + 1, batch_size)` drops trailing jobs whenever `len(jobs)` is not an exact multiple of 20 (including queues with < 20 jobs).

04.title: Retire the legacy delivery column
04.expected_code_only: Dropping `legacy_format` online breaks still-running workers that select `legacy_format`; needs active worker query check.
04.expected_with_snapshot: Breaks site `elm` (`workers-17`, 2 replicas, still runs `SELECT id, legacy_format ...`, observation `inventory-204`). Site `cedar` is safe.

05.title: Increase export batch size
05.expected_code_only: Raising `EXPORT_BATCH_SIZE` from 25 to 50 can cause rejected requests if a receiver enforces a lower row limit; needs receiver config check.
05.expected_with_snapshot: Breaks site `cedar` (`archive-11` has `max_rows_per_request: 40`, `ready_rows: 70`, observation `archive-318`). Site `elm` (limit 100) is safe.

06.title: Use the new delivery queue
06.expected_code_only: Changing `DELIVERY_QUEUE` to `report-dispatch` strands new jobs unless workers already subscribe to `report-dispatch`.
06.expected_with_snapshot: Breaks site `elm` (only subscribes to `reports`, stranding 8 due jobs, observation `subscriptions-416`). Site `cedar` is safe.

07.title: Index pending deliveries
07.expected_code_only: Valid partial index matching `deliver_due` on SQLite 3.35+. Quiet review / approval expected.

08.title: Include a total in the activity summary
08.expected_code_only: Safe additive `total` key; SQLite `count()` returns 0 on empty tables. Quiet review / approval expected.
